footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Gulfport: after $31.7M of preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 48.5% to $1.4B in 2025. Gross margin was 74.8%, versus 63.3% a year earlier, and operating income was $600M, up from a $237M loss.
Net income was $396M, or $21.48 per share, after a $266M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $803M and free cash flow $803M, versus $650M.
sources: Gulfport Energy Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
